forms.relationship: ranked headline measures with short definitions
forms.priority: Use for 2–4 decision-critical measures; lead with the measure that changes the decision.
forms.avoid: Do not imply a trend or compare unlike units.
forms.min_plot: No plot; reserve 32mm width per metric.
forms.labels: Always show measure name, value, unit or denominator, and qualification.
forms.baseline: Align numerals and units; use tabular figures.
forms.value_encodings: Large numeral, explicit unit, and a small text qualifier; identity remains textual.

missing_zero_negative.negative: Use a true minus sign; never color alone.

unit_and_period.unit: Print a unit or denominator beside every metric.
unit_and_period.period: Print the as-of date or covered period for every metric.
unit_and_period.scope: State population, geography, or business scope below the value.

annotation.placement: Place the qualifier directly below its metric.
annotation.content: Explain denominator, identity, and material caveat.
annotation.leader: No leader; proximity binds annotation to value.
annotation.overflow: Move detail to a note rather than shrinking the value.

forms.grayscale: Hierarchy survives through size, weight, and rules.

forms.relationship: additive bridge from opening value through positive and negative drivers to total
forms.priority: Use when components reconcile exactly to an outcome.
forms.avoid: Do not use for independent categories or unreconciled values.
forms.min_plot: At least 95mm wide × 70mm high for five steps.
forms.labels: Label every step, value, unit, and opening/total state.
forms.baseline: All columns share a zero baseline; intermediate bars start at the previous cumulative value.
forms.sort: Causal or accounting sequence; total last.
forms.value_encodings: Solid accent for opening/positive, outlined light fill for deductions, neutral solid total, connectors between cumulative levels.

missing_zero_negative.missing: Omit the step and disclose the gap.
missing_zero_negative.zero: Retain a labelled zero marker when material.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Show a descending outlined bar and true minus sign.

unit_and_period.unit: Use one declared unit for every step and the reconciliation table.
unit_and_period.period: Opening, drivers, and total must share one period.
unit_and_period.scope: State entity and whether the bridge is per-unit or aggregate.

annotation.placement: Place values at bar ends and explanation outside the plot.
annotation.content: Name exceptional drivers and disclose reconciliation limits.
annotation.leader: Use a thin solid leader only when a label is displaced.
annotation.overflow: Move driver commentary to the adjacent table note.

forms.grayscale: Fill, outline, connectors, and signed labels distinguish roles.

forms.priority: Use when readers must choose among discrete options.
forms.avoid: Do not mix criteria or hide the basis of a preferred column.
forms.min_plot: At least 155mm wide for one label column and three options.
forms.labels: State each criterion, option, unit, and scoring scale.
forms.baseline: Align values within rows and repeat units in headers.
forms.sort: Criteria by decision importance; options in a declared order.
forms.value_encodings: Text and numerals in cells; preferred option gets a restrained tint plus explicit wording.

missing_zero_negative.negative: Use signed values and explanatory labels.

unit_and_period.unit: Declare units in each criterion row or its header.
unit_and_period.period: Use the same as-of date or forecast horizon across options.
unit_and_period.scope: State which option boundary and cost components are included.

annotation.placement: Attach notes to the affected criterion or option heading.
annotation.content: Explain scoring basis, preference, and exceptions.
annotation.leader: No leader inside cells; use note markers with matching text.
annotation.overflow: Move long rationale below the matrix without changing column widths.

forms.grayscale: Preferred option remains legible through labels and weight, not tint alone.

forms.relationship: outcome across two categorical or ordinal variables
forms.priority: Use for interaction, sensitivity, or threshold scanning.
forms.avoid: Do not use continuous-looking color without printed values.
forms.min_plot: At least 110mm square for a 3×3 matrix.
forms.labels: Name both axes, every level, each cell value, unit, and legend meaning.
forms.baseline: Not applicable; maintain equal cell dimensions.
forms.sort: Both axes low-to-high or in a declared business order.
forms.value_encodings: Sequential tint plus printed signed value in every cell.

missing_zero_negative.missing: Hatch or label N/A; never assign a color-bin value.
missing_zero_negative.zero: Print 0 and place it in the defined neutral bin.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Print a true minus sign; color depth must not be the only sign cue.

unit_and_period.unit: Declare one outcome unit for all cells.
unit_and_period.period: State the modeled or observed period in the subtitle.
unit_and_period.scope: Name fixed assumptions and the population represented by both axes.

annotation.placement: Place threshold notes beside the matrix and values inside cells.
annotation.content: Explain break-even cells, fixed assumptions, and identity.
annotation.leader: Use a solid leader from a threshold note to one cell only.
annotation.overflow: Move scenario detail to a note; never remove cell values.

forms.grayscale: Printed values and ordered lightness preserve interpretation.

forms.relationship: items positioned by likelihood and impact with explicit response priority
forms.priority: Use for triage, not statistical precision.
forms.avoid: Do not imply measured probability from qualitative placement.
forms.labels: Label axes, item names, ordinal likelihood/impact, and response priority.
forms.baseline: Axes start at the declared lowest ordinal level.
forms.sort: Assign priority separately; place by likelihood and impact.
forms.value_encodings: Position carries likelihood/impact; numbered labels and border styles carry priority.

missing_zero_negative.missing: List as unassessed outside the matrix.
missing_zero_negative.zero: Use lowest labelled ordinal only when zero is defined.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Not applicable; represent beneficial items in another form.

unit_and_period.unit: Declare likelihood and impact scales, even when ordinal.
unit_and_period.period: State the assessment date and risk horizon.
unit_and_period.scope: State the business, geography, and scenario covered.

annotation.placement: Keep item labels inside the plot and method notes below it.
annotation.content: State priority, likelihood, impact, and qualitative basis.
annotation.leader: Use a solid leader only to resolve overlapping labels.
annotation.overflow: Move lower-priority risks to a companion register above the hard limit.

forms.grayscale: Numbers, text labels, and border styles remain distinct without color.

forms.relationship: ordered stages with actions and gated release conditions
forms.priority: Use when timing and stop/go governance matter together.
forms.avoid: Do not present dates without accountable outputs and gates.
forms.min_plot: At least 150mm wide × 28mm high per stage.
forms.labels: Show stage number, date range, action, output, and gate.
forms.baseline: Use a single chronological direction and aligned stage starts.
forms.value_encodings: Stage number and position encode sequence; a ruled gate block encodes release criteria.

missing_zero_negative.missing: Mark date or owner TBD explicitly.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Not applicable; show slippage as signed text.

unit_and_period.unit: Use one time unit across stage ranges and durations.
unit_and_period.period: Print the overall start/end horizon and each stage range.
unit_and_period.scope: State workstream, owner boundary, and release destination.

annotation.placement: Place gates at the end of their stage row.
annotation.content: State measurable output, threshold, owner, and stop action.
annotation.leader: No leader; row alignment binds gate to stage.
annotation.overflow: Continue after a stage boundary and repeat the overall horizon.

forms.grayscale: Sequence, headings, and left rules survive monochrome output.

forms.relationship: primary-source statement paired with observation, interpretation, decision, and limitation
forms.priority: Use only when exact voice materially changes the decision.
forms.avoid: Do not use anonymous decoration or treat one quote as representative evidence.
forms.min_plot: At least 62mm for the quote and 90mm for the analytical aside.
forms.labels: Attribute speaker/source and label observation, interpretation, decision, and limitation.
forms.baseline: Align quote and aside at the first content line.
forms.value_encodings: Typographic quotation and source footer; identity and limitations remain explicit text.

missing_zero_negative.missing: Do not publish without attribution or a stated reason for anonymity.
missing_zero_negative.zero: Render numeric zero verbatim in the quote.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Preserve the speaker's wording and clarify analytical meaning.

unit_and_period.unit: Preserve units exactly inside the quote and define them in the aside.
unit_and_period.period: Give interview date or evidence period in the attribution.
unit_and_period.scope: State speaker role, sample context, and representativeness limit.

annotation.placement: Place attribution below the quote and analysis in the adjacent aside.
annotation.content: Separate observation, interpretation, decision, and limitation.
annotation.leader: No leader; typographic grouping binds note to quote.
annotation.overflow: Trim with an explicit ellipsis or continue as prose; never shrink attribution.

forms.grayscale: Serif quote, rule, and labelled aside preserve hierarchy.

forms.relationship: auditable register of repeated records and status fields
forms.priority: Use when exact row-level evidence matters more than visual trend.
forms.avoid: Do not shrink below the approved dense-table type or change columns across continuation pages.
forms.min_plot: Full content width; minimum 7.8pt type and 1.28 line height.
forms.labels: Repeat column headers; label continuation range and define status symbols.
forms.baseline: Align numeric columns right and text columns left/top.
forms.sort: Stable identifier or declared review priority.
forms.value_encodings: Rows and rules carry records; status combines symbol, text, and line style.

missing_zero_negative.missing: Show — with missing or pending status.
missing_zero_negative.negative: Use a true minus sign and right alignment.

unit_and_period.unit: Declare units in numeric headers and do not mix units within a column.
unit_and_period.period: State register as-of date and repeat it on continuation pages.
unit_and_period.scope: Define included records and exclusions in the table note.

annotation.placement: Use compact notes below the table and markers in affected cells.
annotation.content: Define status symbols, exceptions, and evidence limitations.
annotation.leader: No graphical leader; note markers map cells to notes.
annotation.overflow: Continue rows on a new page with repeated headers and note context.

forms.grayscale: Double, dashed, and single status rules plus text remain distinguishable.
